root_cause.text: The `ethosu_gem_cmdstream_copy_and_validate` function in the Arm Ethos-U NPU driver uses a `WARN_ON(1)` placeholder instead of returning an error when processing the unimplemented `NPU_OP_RESIZE` command submitted by userspace.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in `drivers/accel/ethosu/ethosu_gem.c`, the `WARN_ON(1);` statement under `case NPU_OP_RESIZE:` is replaced with `return -EINVAL;` to reject the command before it reaches the hardware.

intent_record.intent_summary: Return -EINVAL instead of triggering a warning when encountering an unsupported NPU_OP_RESIZE operation during command stream validation.
intent_record.what: Replaced a placeholder WARN_ON(1) and break statement with an immediate return of -EINVAL in the NPU_OP_RESIZE case.
intent_record.how: Prevents the driver from continuing to process an unsupported NPU_OP_RESIZE command, instead safely rejecting the command stream with an error code.

grouping_result.intent: Return -EINVAL instead of triggering a warning when encountering an unsupported NPU_OP_RESIZE operation during command stream validation.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the vulnerability by replacing the WARN_ON placeholder with an actual error return (-EINVAL) when encountering the unsupported NPU_OP_RESIZE operation.
